title: Shop: full car design previews + Race track marker matches active car

requirements.summary: Enhance Shop browsing to present each car design/model with a live visual preview and allow purchasing a specific design+color variant while preserving owned-state behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Each car model/design in the shop has a clear visual preview of the design (e.g., using the existing 3D car viewer component) that updates when the user changes the selected variant (color) for that design.
Users can still purchase a specific variant (design + color) as they do today.
Owned variants remain clearly indicated and cannot be re-purchased (current behavior preserved).

file_operations.description: Add a per-model visual preview panel using the existing CarViewer3D component so each model card shows the full design and updates as the selected color changes; initialize a sensible default selected color per model on catalog load so previews render without extra clicks; keep variant purchase flow intact (design+color mapped to the existing catalog variant id). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Preserve owned-state rules while improving UX: allow selecting owned variants for preview (do not disable color selection), keep owned variants clearly indicated, and ensure the purchase button remains disabled (and labeled appropriately) when the currently selected variant is owned.

requirements.summary: Update the Race page track visualization to render the moving player marker using the active car’s design and color (with a consistent fallback when no active car is selected).
acceptanceCriteria: On the Race page, the moving player marker in the track visualization reflects the active car’s color and design (derived from the active car’s catalog entry).
If no active car is selected, the track visualization uses the existing fallback car ("Default Racer", blue) consistently with the existing 3D viewer fallback.
No Internet Identity login state regressions: the Race page still works in practice/demo and logged-out scenarios as it does now.

file_operations.description: Create a lightweight track marker component that can visually differentiate car designs (based on modelName) and apply the selected CarColor, suitable for use inside TrackVisualization (non-Canvas, small UI element).

Extend TrackVisualization props to accept the player's active car modelName and CarColor; render the player's moving marker using the new TrackCarMarker (design+color) instead of the generic lucide Car icon; keep ghost lanes unchanged or continue using the generic icon for opponents.

Wire the active car information already resolved in RacePage (active car from catalog with fallback to "Default Racer" + blue) into TrackVisualization so the track marker matches the same car shown in CarViewer3D; ensure behavior remains unchanged for practice/demo mode and logged-out sessions.
